name: Swords for Hire
text: You must hire a Guild Captain to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Guild Barracks stronghold.

name: Disgraced Noble
text: You must hire a Noble to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Dilapidated Manor stronghold.

name: Witch Hunters Guild
text: You must hire a Witch Hunter to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Chapter House stronghold.

name: Wizard's Retinue
text: You must hire a High Wizard of the Guild to lead your warband. You begin the campaign with the Hidden Library stronghold.
